Joel: Quick sync — proposing sidebar regroup: combine 'Models' + 'Endpoints' under a 'Serving' group. Goal: reduce depth and surface deploy-related flows together. Wanted: quick sanity check on deep links, breadcrumbs, and keyboard nav before we lock.
Maya: Sketch looks good. Two concerns: (1) Breadcrumb semantics — when you open a model version detail from an embed link, should breadcrumb show 'Models > MyModel > v1' or 'Serving > Models > MyModel > v1'? Prefer the latter if we keep Serving in primary nav. (2) Need clear 'back' behavior for modals vs routes. :thinking_face:
Sara: Deep link question: if we change grouping, will old URLs like /models/123/version/3 still work? We should support redirects with 301-ish behavior client-side + server for SEO. Also add a canonical param so embeds don't break.
Andy: Routing nit: let's keep stable route patterns. Proposal: alias old routes to new ones and keep a minimal router map:
```
/models/:id -> /serving/models/:id
/models/:id/versions/:vid -> /serving/models/:id/versions/:vid
```
Client should pushState -> replaceState for redirects so history isn't noisy.
nav-api-bot: Auto: Figma mock updated by Joel — https://www.figma.com/file/abc123/sidenav-regroup. Also added a11y checklist: aria-current on active item, focus trap avoid on slideouts.
Maya: A11y: when deep linking into a subsection (#metrics), ensure focus lands on the heading and `aria-live` announces context. Also add `role="navigation"` on sidebar and skip-link target for main content.
Joel: Good. Also debating collapsed vs full groups on mobile — collapsing 'Serving' by default? Thoughts.
Sara: Collapse by default helps scannability. But remember keyboard users should be able to expand with Enter/Space. Ensure `aria-expanded` on toggles.
Andy: One more: breadcrumbs should be linkable. Each crumb should be real route (no JS-only). That keeps copy/pasteable URLs.
Joel: Action items: Andy — router alias PR + tests. Sara — list out redirect matrix. Maya — update figma with breadcrumb examples and add a11y text. I'll schedule a short design/eng sync tomorrow. :thumbsup:
